# Progress list (`progress-list`)

Several jobs at once: name, percentage, bar and a status line each.

Group: Feedback. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/feedback';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createProgressList` (types in `dist/web/feedback/progressList.d.ts`): `ul.mh-progress-list`: several jobs at once (downloads, updates, backups). Each `li.__item` has a `__header` (`__name` and the `__value` percentage in tabular figures), a `.mh-progress` bar named by the item, and a muted `__meta` line "status · detail". `null` values show an indeterminate bar and no percentage.

```ts
export function createProgressList(options: ProgressListOptions): ProgressListHandle;

export interface ProgressListOptions {
  items: ProgressListItem[];
  /** Accessible name of the list ("Downloads", "Updates"). */
  label?: string;
}

export interface ProgressListHandle {
  el: HTMLUListElement;
  /** Updates rows in place (bars animate to their new value); adds or removes rows to match. */
  setItems(items: ProgressListItem[]): void;
}

export interface ProgressListItem {
  name: string;
  /** 0 to 100; `null` is indeterminate (no percentage shown). */
  value: number | null;
  /** What is happening ("Downloading", "Paused"). */
  status?: string | null;
  /** More about it ("1.2 of 3.4 GB", "12 min left"). Shown after the status as "status · detail". */
  detail?: string | null;
  tone?: ProgressTone;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createProgressList, type ProgressListItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const jobs = (step: number): ProgressListItem[] => {
  const firmware = Math.min(100, step * 10);
  return [
    {
      name: 'Hallway sensor firmware',
      value: firmware,
      status: firmware === 100 ? 'Installed' : 'Updating',
      detail: 'Version 2.3.1',
      tone: firmware === 100 ? 'success' : 'accent',
    },
    { name: 'Weekly backup', value: Math.min(100, 40 + step * 4), status: 'Uploading', detail: 'of 3.4 GB' },
    { name: 'Garden map', value: null, status: 'Preparing' },
  ];
};

const list = createProgressList({ label: 'Updates and backups', items: jobs(0) });

let step = 0;
const timer = setInterval(() => {
  step += 1;
  list.setItems(jobs(step));
  if (step === 15) clearInterval(timer);
}, 800);

document.body.append(list.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { ProgressList } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { ProgressListItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const jobs = (step: number): ProgressListItem[] => {
  const firmware = Math.min(100, step * 10);
  return [
    {
      name: 'Hallway sensor firmware',
      value: firmware,
      status: firmware === 100 ? 'Installed' : 'Updating',
      detail: 'Version 2.3.1',
      tone: firmware === 100 ? 'success' : 'accent',
    },
    { name: 'Weekly backup', value: Math.min(100, 40 + step * 4), status: 'Uploading', detail: 'of 3.4 GB' },
    { name: 'Garden map', value: null, status: 'Preparing' },
  ];
};

export function ProgressListExample() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (step >= 15) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setStep((s) => s + 1), 800);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [step]);
  return <ProgressList label="Updates and backups" items={jobs(step)} />;
}
```
